sources.title: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, Awareness guide on the rights and duties of employers and workers (December 2025): Official holidays
sources.said: Eid al-Fitr For 4 days Starting the day after Ramadan 29; Eid al-Adha For 4 days It starts from the day of standing at Arafat; National Day For 1 day September 23; Founding Day For 1 day February 22. Note: If official holidays or occasions overlap with the following • Weekly rest days: Time off before or after ... • National or Founding Day overlapping with either Eid: No compensation shall be provided

sources.title: The Implementing Regulations of Labor Law and its Annexes (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development), article 24
sources.said: Eid al-Fitr holiday shall be 4 days effective from the day following the 29 th Ramadan, as per Um al-Qura calendar. Eid al-Adha holiday shall be 4 days effective from the day of Arafat. ... In case the Eids and ceremonies leaves coincides with the followings: 1. Weekend: The worker shall be compensated for the same exact number of days before or after those leaves.

sources.title: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development announces the Founding Day holiday for Private and Non-profit Sectors (8 March 2026)
sources.said: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development announces that the Founding Day of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for this year, which is on Sunday, 5 Ramadan 1447 AH, corresponding to 22 February 2026, is an official holiday for the public, private and non-profit sectors.

sources.title: Gulf News, Saudi Arabia announces Eid Al Fitr holidays for private and non-profit sectors (the Ministry of Human Resources)
sources.said: the break to begin at the end of the working day on Wednesday, March 18, 2026 ... will last for four days
